en.個 ATR，不超過追價上限。數量按限價（最差成交價）計，所以可能比參數卡少，每單: ATR, no higher than the chase limit. The quantity uses the limit (the worst fill), so it can be smaller than on the parameter card, with the same maximum loss per unit; a gap through the invalidation level makes the real loss larger. Some brokers require a buy stop’s trigger to be above the current price: once the pre-market price is past the trigger, the preset parameters no longer apply, and such cases, like setups already above the pivot, are checked after the open instead. The attached stop is a stop-market order that triggers only in regular hours; some broker screens have no “attached order” for this order type, so a separate sell stop is then needed after the fill. Short selling needs a margin account and shares available to borrow.
